2608.01106.title: SG-Layout: Structured Scene Graph-Guided Layout Generation with LLMs
2608.01106.paper_summary: Understanding and generating spatially coherent layouts from natural language remains a fundamental yet challenging task for large language models (LLMs). Existing LLMs often struggle to capture explicit geometric relationships and structural dependencies between objects. To address this issue, we propose SG-Layout, a graph-guided layout generation framework that explicitly incorporates structured spatial knowledge into LLMs. SG-Layout follows a two-stage training paradigm: (1) a graph-language feature alignment stage, where a relational graph encoder and a projector are trained to map scene-graph embeddings into the LLM's linguistic space; and (2) an instruction tuning stage, where LoRA-based adapters enable efficient fine-tuning for instruction-driven layout generation while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate SG-Layout on image layout generation, indoor scene synthesis and robotic object rearrangement tasks. Experimental results show that SG-Layout improves spatial reasoning accuracy and geometric consistency over the compact open-source backbone, with particularly clear advantages in relation-dense and compositionally complex scenes. These results highlight the effectiveness of graph-structured feature alignment for enhancing controllable layout generation.
2608.01106.paper_summary_zh: 理解和生成具有空間一致性的佈局從自然語言仍然是大型語言模型（LLMs）的一項基本但具有挑戰性的任務。現有的LLMs通常難以捕捉物體之間的明確幾何關係和結構依賴性。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了SG-Layout，一個圖形引導的佈局生成框架，明確將結構化的空間知識納入LLMs中。SG-Layout遵循兩階段的訓練範式：（1）圖形-語言特徵對齊階段，在這一階段中，關係圖編碼器和投影器被訓練以將場景圖嵌入映射到LLM的語言空間；（2）指令調整階段，在這一階段中，基於LoRA的適配器使得在保持主幹不變的情況下，能夠高效地進行指令驅動的佈局生成微調。我們在圖像佈局生成、室內場景合成和機器人物體重排任務上評估了SG-Layout。實驗結果顯示，SG-Layout在空間推理準確性和幾何一致性方面優於緊湊的開源主幹，尤其在關係密集和組合複雜的場景中具有明顯的優勢。這些結果突顯了圖結構特徵對齊在增強可控佈局生成方面的有效性。
